propositions: Canonical Bedrock model ids containing colons (e.g. 'anthropic.claude-opus-4-5-20251101-v1:0') are silently treated as already-qualified and the configured provider='bedrock' is discarded.
The _resolve_target function's colon-scan test misidentifies version suffixes as provider qualifiers, causing downstream infer_provider to parse model id fragments as provider names.
Configured provider is not checked first, allowing model id punctuation to overrule explicit provider settings (e.g. _resolve_target('openai:gpt-4o', provider='bedrock') still drops bedrock).
Two independent implementations (_resolve_target and infer_provider) of the qualification-detection logic can diverge, and both failed identically on versioned Bedrock ids.
Conflicting provider qualifiers (inline colon vs configured provider parameter) are silently resolved by picking one, discarding explicit user intent without error.
